import json,base64,pathlib,urllib.request,tempfile,os,subprocess
files=['saas/console/_core/Bootstrap.php','saas/console/_core/TenantVoiceSession.php','saas/console/device/v1/tts.php']
token=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/ontrack-voice-link/config.json').read_text())['token']
report=[]
for path in files:
 req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/OnTrack-Development/OnTrack-voice/contents/'+path+'?ref=feat%2Fv1-io-premium-20261107',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','User-Agent':'IOPremium-PHP-Lint'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as r:data=json.loads(r.read(160000))
 raw=base64.b64decode(data['content'])
 fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.php')
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(raw)
  proc=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/php','-l',temp],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
  report.append({'file':path,'ok':proc.returncode==0,'error':proc.stderr[:180]})
 finally:os.unlink(temp)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS' if all(x['ok'] for x in report) else 'FAIL','results':report},separators=(',',':')))
if not all(x['ok'] for x in report):raise SystemExit(1)
